## Research

My research lies at the intersection of algebraic topology, homotopy theory, combinatorial topology, and topological data analysis. Current interests include combinatorial models for homotopy theory, multiparameter persistence, and density-aware topological methods.

See the [Research](research.qmd) and [Publications](publications.qmd) pages for more information.

## Supervision and mentoring

I have supervised **nine completed master's students** and **three completed PhD students**.

At the University of Bergen, I have been main supervisor for seven master's students and two PhD students. At the University of Dar es Salaam, I have co-supervised two master's students and one PhD student.

I have also mentored a postdoctoral fellow, Nello Blaser, now professor in the Department of Informatics at the University of Bergen.

## Teaching and international collaboration

I have taught mathematics at undergraduate, master's, and PhD level for more than twenty years.

In 2023 I taught differential topology at the University of Dar es Salaam. I have participated in the **Mathematics for Sustainable Development (MATH4SDG)** collaboration between the University of Bergen, the University of Dar es Salaam, and Makerere University, and I continue to collaborate with colleagues in Tanzania on topological data analysis.

See the [Teaching](teaching.qmd) page for more information.
